# Dogfooding Product Sources

This folder preserves external sources used for the maintained wiki page:

- `wiki/topics/ai-product-product-definition/Dogfooding作为产品验证机制.md`

## Sources

- `joel-spolsky-work-of-dogs.html`
  - URL: https://www.joelonsoftware.com/2001/05/05/what-is-the-work-of-dogs-in-this-country/
  - Focus: Fog Creek / CityDesk dogfooding as real-task product testing.
- `graphite-onboarding-roulette.html`
  - URL: https://graphite.dev/blog/onboarding-roulette
  - Focus: onboarding roulette as dogfooding for a low-frequency but critical flow.
- `gitlab-customer-0.html`
  - URL: https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/product/product-processes/customer-0/
  - Focus: internal team members as first customers before broader release.
- `gitlab-dogfooding-for-rd.html`
  - URL: https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/product/product-processes/dogfooding-for-r-d/
  - Focus: R&D team using GitLab as much as possible for daily work.
- `gitlab-product-processes.html`
  - URL: https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/product/product-processes/
  - Focus: broader product-process context and feedback issues.
- `wikipedia-eating-your-own-dog-food.html`
  - URL: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eating_your_own_dog_food
  - Focus: definition, origin, benefits, and criticism.
- `ibm-cloud-dogfooding-arxiv.html`
  - URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/1907.06094
  - Focus: IBM Cloud services used to monitor IBM Cloud infrastructure.
- `smart-home-dogfooding-arxiv.html`
  - URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/1510.01050
  - Focus: smart-home end-user development system deployed first in project members' homes.
- `codex-agentic-ai-dogfooding-arxiv.html`
  - URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.26959
  - Focus: Codex internal adoption as a related AI-agent workflow case.
